title: ATDD Binding Lock Schema
description: Resolved substrate binding plan (.atdd/binding.lock.yaml). Keyed to a substrate-lock digest; records, per convention, whether gating is bound-owned by an admitted implementation/workspace or left to a legacy-fallback validator. Produced by the binder (atdd bind --check); never executes implementation code to build it.

package_id.description: The admitted package that OWNS this rule, i.e. the substrate.lock.yaml artifact whose implementation realizes it. Without it a bound rule cannot be traced back to an installed package, and the substrate coherence invariant (no rule may be bound to a package absent from substrate.lock.yaml) is unprovable. Optional in the schema only so a lock written by an older core still parses; the binder always writes it, and `atdd substrate remove` refuses to report success without it.
